mapper.select: /* UserAuthMapper.existsUser 사용자ID가 등록되어 있는지 판별 */ SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_USR_M WHERE USR_ID = #{usrId})
mapper.insert: /* UserAuthMapper.insertUser 사용자를 등록 (초기 비밀번호, 최초로그인여부 Y, 로그인오류건수 0) */ INSERT INTO TB_USR_M ( USR_ID, USR_NM, PWD, EMP_NO, DEPT_CD, EML_ADDR, MOBL_NO, USR_STAT_CD, USR_LOCK_YN, USR_CLS_CD, ECOM_DT, RESI_DT, USE_ST_DT, USE_END_DT, USE_YN, FIRS_LGIN_YN, LGIN_ERR_CNT, FIRS_REGR_ID, FIRS_REG_DT, FINA_REGR_ID, FINA_REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{item.usrId}, #{item.usrNm}, #{pwd}, NULLIF(#{item.empNo}, ''), NULLIF(#{item.deptCd}, ''), NULLIF(#{item.emlAddr}, ''), NULLIF(#{item.moblNo}, ''), NULLIF(#{item.usrStatCd}, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{item.usrLockYn}, ''), 'N'), NULLIF(#{item.usrClsCd}, ''), NULLIF(#{item.ecomDt}, ''), NULLIF(#{item.resiDt}, ''), NULLIF(#{item.stDt}, ''), NULLIF(#{item.endDt}, ''), #{item.useYn}, 'Y', 0, #{regrId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{regrId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: /* UserAuthMapper.updateUser 사용자를 수정 */ UPDATE TB_USR_M SET USR_NM = #{item.usrNm}, EMP_NO = NULLIF(#{item.empNo}, ''), DEPT_CD = NULLIF(#{item.deptCd}, ''), EML_ADDR = NULLIF(#{item.emlAddr}, ''), MOBL_NO = NULLIF(#{item.moblNo}, ''), USR_STAT_CD = NULLIF(#{item.usrStatCd}, ''), USR_LOCK_DTTM = CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(#{item.usrLockYn}, ''), 'N') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(USR_LOCK_YN, 'N') = 'N' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(#{item.usrLockYn}, ''), 'N') = 'N' THEN NULL ELSE USR_LOCK_DTTM END, LGIN_ERR_CNT = CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(#{item.usrLockYn}, ''), 'N') = 'N' AND COALESCE(USR_LOCK_YN, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE LGIN_ERR_CNT END, USR_LOCK_YN = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{item.usrLockYn}, ''), 'N'), USR_CLS_CD = NULLIF(#{item.usrClsCd}, ''), ECOM_DT = NULLIF(#{item.ecomDt}, ''), RESI_DT = NULLIF(#{item.resiDt}, ''), USE_ST_DT = NULLIF(#{item.stDt}, ''), USE_END_DT = NULLIF(#{item.endDt}, ''), USE_YN = #{item.useYn}, FINA_REGR_ID = #{regrId}, FINA_REG_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USR_ID = #{item.usrId}

/* UserAuthMapper.updateUserPasswordReset 사용자 비밀번호를 초기 비밀번호로 초기화 (최초로그인여부 Y, 로그인오류건수 0, 잠금 해제) */ UPDATE TB_USR_M SET PWD = #{pwd}, PWD_CHG_DTTM = NULL, FIRS_LGIN_YN = 'Y', LGIN_ERR_CNT = 0, USR_LOCK_YN = 'N', USR_LOCK_DTTM = NULL, FINA_REGR_ID = #{regrId}, FINA_REG_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USR_ID = #{usrId}
mapper.insert: /* UserAuthMapper.insertUserComponentAuth 사용자 컴포넌트 권한을 등록 (이미 있으면 권한여부 수정) */ INSERT INTO TB_USR_CMPN_R ( USR_ID, PRGM_ID, CMPN_ID, AUTH_YN, FIRS_REGR_ID, FIRS_REG_DT, FINA_REGR_ID, FINA_REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{item.usrId}, #{item.prgmId}, #{item.cmpnId}, #{item.authYn}, #{regrId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{regrId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (USR_ID, PRGM_ID, CMPN_ID) DO UPDATE SET AUTH_YN = EXCLUDED.AUTH_YN, FINA_REGR_ID = EXCLUDED.FINA_REGR_ID, FINA_REG_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
